status: Native Support ticket writer qualified end-to-end in desktop and mobile browsers for the general ticket lifecycle; order-backed browser path, asset visibility negative and the other Support workflows remain open

runtime.account: normal Account email/password sign-in at account-dev-erpx.jesadakorn.com
runtime.supportApp: apps/support on 127.0.0.1:3285 with the cohort native session and ERPX_NATIVE_SUPPORT_TICKET_CONFIG
runtime.nativeWriter: private-api on 127.0.0.1:44993 with supportTicketWrites for h001/company
runtime.gateway: owned cohort gateway on 3445 with /support, /__erpx/support, /support/cases and /api/v1/holdings/acme/support routed to the Support app
runtime.transport: browser -> cohort relay 44994 -> gateway 3445 -> Support app 3285 -> native writer 44993

lifecycle.ui: The owner and manager open the ticket through the record drawer at /support/cases/{id}/overview. The manager assigns the owner and due date; the owner accepts the case, records the proposed resolution and the independent manager confirms the outcome and closes.

fixes: The HTTP route strips the browser-supplied ticket id before strict TicketChange deserialization; the PostgreSQL HTTP test now covers a change request with id and asserts version 2.
The assembled private API boundary admits POST /api/v1/holdings/{slug}/support only for the configured supportTicketWrites target; the direct router test alone did not exercise this boundary.
limits: The browser lifecycle used a general ticket. Order-backed create with a customer-note confirmation and typed asset source are PostgreSQL-tested only.
The asset source visibility negative case (an unreadable source must hide the ticket body/link) is PostgreSQL-tested through the source policy but has no browser journey.
The Support owner remains open: SLA watch, incidents, sessions, capabilities and attachments are separate native workflows.

The Support app logs React hydration console warnings on navigation (5 in a full lifecycle run); pageErrors stay 0. The warnings are not caused by the native writer and are recorded rather than hidden.
next: Add the order-backed customer-note confirmation and asset visibility negative to the browser journey, then close or formally scope the remaining Support workflows before the scoped PR.
